RUNEPRIEST-INCANTATION_POWER.title: Incantation
RUNEPRIEST-INCANTATION_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, your runes are [gold]Spoken[/gold] from left to right, then cleared.
RUNEPRIEST-INCANTATION_POWER.smartDescri: At the end of your turn, your runes are [gold]Spoken[/gold] from left to right, then cleared.
RUNEPRIEST-FLOW_STATE_POWER.title: Flow State
RUNEPRIEST-FLOW_STATE_POWER.description: This turn, whenever you [gold]Inscribe[/gold], draw cards.
RUNEPRIEST-ETERNAL_SIGIL_POWER.title: Eternal Sigil
RUNEPRIEST-ETERNAL_SIGIL_POWER.descripti: Your Incantation is no longer cleared after you [gold]Speak[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-ETERNAL_SIGIL_POWER.smartDesc: Your Incantation is no longer cleared after you [gold]Speak[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-RUNIC_FORM_POWER.title: Runic Form
RUNEPRIEST-RUNIC_FORM_POWER.description: The first two runes you [gold]Inscribe[/gold] each turn are wrapped in a closed [blue]Loop[/blue].
RUNEPRIEST-RUNIC_FORM_POWER.smartDescrip: The first two runes you [gold]Inscribe[/gold] each turn are wrapped in a closed [blue]Loop[/blue] 2.
RUNEPRIEST-ODD_SIGIL_POWER.title: Odd Sigil
RUNEPRIEST-ODD_SIGIL_POWER.description: Every 2nd rune you [gold]Inscribe[/gold] each turn has its values doubled.
RUNEPRIEST-ODD_SIGIL_POWER.smartDescript: Every 2nd rune you [gold]Inscribe[/gold] each turn has its values doubled.
RUNEPRIEST-STAR_SIGIL_POWER.title: Star Sigil
RUNEPRIEST-STAR_SIGIL_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Inscribe[/gold] [blue]Nova[/blue].
RUNEPRIEST-STAR_SIGIL_POWER.smartDescrip: At the start of your turn, [gold]Inscribe[/gold] [blue]Nova[/blue].
RUNEPRIEST-WARDING_SIGIL_POWER.title: Warding Sigil
RUNEPRIEST-WARDING_SIGIL_POWER.descripti: After you [gold]Speak[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] for each rune Spoken.
RUNEPRIEST-WARDING_SIGIL_POWER.smartDesc: After you [gold]Speak[/gold], gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold] for each rune Spoken.
RUNEPRIEST-AMPLIFY_SIGIL_POWER.title: Amplify Sigil
RUNEPRIEST-AMPLIFY_SIGIL_POWER.descripti: All runes that can be amplified are stronger.
RUNEPRIEST-AMPLIFY_SIGIL_POWER.smartDesc: All runes that can be amplified gain {Amount}.
RUNEPRIEST-SWIFT_SIGIL_POWER.title: Swift Sigil
RUNEPRIEST-SWIFT_SIGIL_POWER.description: Whenever a rune is removed from your Incantation without being [gold]Spoken[/gold], draw cards.
RUNEPRIEST-SWIFT_SIGIL_POWER.smartDescri: Whenever a rune is removed from your Incantation without being [gold]Spoken[/gold] (or fizzles), draw {Amount} {Amount:plural:card|cards}.
RUNEPRIEST-HOLY_WATER_SIGIL_POWER.title: Holy Water Sigil
RUNEPRIEST-HOLY_WATER_SIGIL_POWER.descri: Whenever you heal HP, deal that much damage to an enemy.
RUNEPRIEST-HOLY_WATER_SIGIL_POWER.smartD: Whenever you heal HP, deal that much damage to {Amount:choose(1):a random enemy|ALL enemies}.
RUNEPRIEST-BARRIER_OF_LIGHT_POWER.title: Barrier of Light
RUNEPRIEST-BARRIER_OF_LIGHT_POWER.descri: Until your next turn, all damage you take is halved.
RUNEPRIEST-BARRIER_OF_LIGHT_POWER.smartD: Until your next turn, all damage you take is halved.
RUNEPRIEST-PALADIN_SIGIL_POWER.title: Paladin Sigil
RUNEPRIEST-LINGERING_AROMA_POWER.title: Lingering Aroma

RUNEPRIEST-LINGERING_AROMA_POWER.smartDe: This turn, your Incantation is not cleared after you [gold]Speak[/gold].
